_comment: THE canonical dispatch-scan-modal → Modal request body. One example, both
sides. The Deno test (lib.test.ts) asserts the dispatcher builds a body with
exactly this key set; the pytest (services/scan-modal/tests/test_contract.py)
asserts scan_modal's parse_spawn_body accepts it and verify_job finds its
input keys. Neither side owns the contract, so neither can drift alone —
which is how meshPlyUrl/capturedRoomUrl on one side and
meshUrl/capturedRoomJsonUrl on the other went unnoticed until now.
Every value here is a placeholder; only the SHAPE is normative.
_comment itself is not part of the contract and is ignored by both readers.
